facts.text: Under the Gustie Guarantee, every admitted student who files the FAFSA receives at least $30,000 per year in scholarships, totaling $120,000 over four years.

sources.title: The Gustie Guarantee | Gustavus Adolphus College
sources.quote: Regardless of your family's income, we'll give you at least $30,000 in scholarships each year for four years ($120,000 total) when you're admitted and file the FAFSA.
